findings.title: Indexed search returns matches from the whole storage, not just the caller's folder, so it leaks other users' file names
findings.evidence: const where = ['root = ?', 'instr(name_lower, ?) > 0']; const args = [at.root, needle]. There is no `rel` prefix condition for the start folder (at.rel). Request: GET /api/search?space=home&q=passport as a normal user, or GET /api/search?space=public&q=x as a visitor. Once the index is built the query runs over the whole storage root and returns names, sizes and mtimes of other users' private files.

findings.title: Version restore needs only the 'read' permission, so a read-only user can overwrite a file
findings.evidence: `.post('/:id/restore', ... const a = need({ user, ip }, body.space, 'read')`. Restore replaces the file with renameSync(stage, abs). Request: POST /api/versions/<id>/restore {space:'public', path:'/report.docx'} from a user with only read on public.

findings.title: Copy or move into another space checks only 'read' on the destination
findings.evidence: `const d = cross ? need({ user, ip }, body.destSpace, 'read') : a`. Request: POST /api/copy {space:'home', items:['/a.bin'], dest:'/', destSpace:'public'} from a user whose publicPermissions is only ['read']; copyTree writes into the public folder.

findings.title: Stored file versions are not counted in a home's quota usage
findings.evidence: `cache.set(k, { root, size: r.size, ... })`; versionBytesUnder is imported but never called. Repeated PUT /api/content keeps copies in DATA_DIR/versions outside the counted usage, up to VERSIONS_KEEP times the quota.

findings.title: indexTouched returns before removing rows when the path no longer exists, so deleted/renamed entries stay searchable
findings.evidence: `if (!st || st.isSymbolicLink()) return` runs before `removeRows(d, at.root, at.rel)`. After POST /api/delete, /rename or /move the old names still come back in GET /api/search until the next rescan.

findings.title: Favorites and recent lists do not re-check the read permission
findings.evidence: `const a = accessFor(user, r.space); if (!a) continue`. accessFor returns access for any non-empty permission set, so a user left with only upload still gets names, sizes and mtimes of saved paths from GET /api/me/favorites and /api/me/recent.

findings.title: The office token signing key (office-links.key) is not excluded from backups
findings.evidence: SKIP lists secret.key but not office-links.key (paths.officeKey, the HMAC key for document-server link tokens); collectItems() adds it to every backup zip, downloadable via GET /api/admin/backups/:name/download. The document-server JWT is still required, so impact is limited.
